```python
from datetime import datetime, timedelta

# Step 1: Check for existing events at 10:00 on 2024-05-19
events = get_day_calendar_events("2024-05-19")

class HasEventAtTime(BaseModel):
    has_event: bool

# Check if there is an event at 10:00
has_event_at_10 = query_ai_assistant(
    "Given the following events, is there any event that starts at or overlaps with 10:00 on 2024-05-19? Respond with True if yes, otherwise False. Here are the events: {}"
    .format(events),
    HasEventAtTime
)

if has_event_at_10.has_event:
    start_time = "2024-05-19 16:00"
    end_time = "2024-05-19 17:00"
else:
    start_time = "2024-05-19 10:00"
    end_time = "2024-05-19 11:00"

create_calendar_event(
    title="Follow-up meeting",
    start_time=start_time,
    end_time=end_time,
    description="Follow-up meeting to discuss the project.",
    participants=None,
    location=None
)
```
